headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when AEW welcomed AR Fox for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a solid showing. Fox teamed with Top Flight in a losing effort to challenge for the Trios Titles, but his effort was strong enough that AEW offered him a contract on the spot after the match.
That Saturday in 2024, Mariah May vs. Anna Jay fought it out in a No DQ match, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 6.78 spotlighting the women's division.

That Wednesday in 2022, Jun Akiyama wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.47 ? a solid showing. Making his AEW debut alongside Konosuke Takeshita, the AJPW and NOAH legend pinned Ortiz with an exploder suplex ? fulfilling a dream match Eddie Kingston had been chasing for years.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2022, when Hook vs. Lee Moriarty went to battle over the FTW Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.78. Hook was challenging for gold for the very first time.
On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Castagnoli & Danielson arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.30 ? a well-worked match.
2024 brought us this moment: Shelton Benjamin vs. Komander locked horns for the first time on Collision, rated 6.72.
